description: The bar chart illustrates GLUE performance scores for different fine-tuning methods, shown separately for two RoBERTa model sizes. The horizontal axis contains the categorical fine-tuning methods labeled (left to right) Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S₁-model, S₄-model, and S₅-model, with the axis label “Fine-tuning Method.” The vertical axis is labeled “GLUE Performance” and uses a linear numeric scale with visible tick labels at 86 and 88 (units not explicitly stated), spanning roughly the mid‑84s up to just above 89 based on the bar heights. Each category has a grouped pair of bars: a blue bar for “base” and an orange bar for “large,” as indicated by the legend titled “RoBERTa Size” in the upper-left. Approximate values by group are: Prefix (base ≈84.6, large ≈85.7), Adaptor (base ≈84.4, large ≈88.1), LoRA (base ≈86.6, large ≈88.9), BitFit (base ≈84.3, large ≈87.7), S₁-model (base ≈85.6, large ≈85.6), S₄-model (base ≈86.2, large ≈87.6), and S₅-model (base ≈87.0, large ≈89.2). The bars are arranged in the fixed left-to-right method order (not visibly sorted by value), and there are no additional visual emphases such as annotations, outlines, or shading beyond the two color encodings.
